clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, the Etched Rune invites aspiring dwarven hunters to Anvilmar. Hunter trainer Thorgas Grimson sends it to begin their formal wilderness instruction.

The Etched Rune bears dwarven runes and reaches novices who show promise in Coldridge Valley’s snowdrifts. Mountaineer and hunter trainer Thorgas Grimson sends it to call fledgling trackers to Anvilmar. The rune marks their first step beyond basic survival and into the craft of the wild: respecting Dun Morogh’s beasts, tracking mountain predators, caring for ranged weapons, and enduring the harsh elements.
